questions.question: Why does Cao Cao think he has a chance to kill Dong Zhuo?
options: Dong Zhuo trusts him and expects a visit.
Wang Yun has already arrested Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo plans to leave Luoyang alone.
questions.explanation: 董卓信任曹操，而且约好次日见面，给了曹操接近他的机会。

evidence.quote: Cao Cao looked around the room. "Dong Zhuo trusts me. In fact, I'm supposed to meet with him tomorrow."

questions.question: Why does Cao Cao like the seven-star dagger for his plan?
options: It will frighten all the guards.
It is easy to hide in his robe.
It belonged to Dong Zhuo as a child.
questions.explanation: 曹操说匕首很容易藏起来，随后将它藏进袍子。

evidence.quote: Cao Cao admired the dagger. "Perfect. This will be easy to hide." He slipped it into his robe and looked around the room. "I will not fail you."

questions.question: How does Cao Cao realize Dong Zhuo is awake?
options: A servant warns him from the stable.
A guard wakes Dong Zhuo with a shout.
He sees Dong Zhuo staring at him in the mirror.
questions.explanation: 曹操在镜子里看到董卓的倒影正盯着自己，才意识到情况危险。

evidence.quote: A large mirror stood behind the couch. Cao Cao could see his reflection in the mirror. Then he gulped. Dong Zhuo's reflection was staring directly at him!

questions.question: What does Cao Cao say when the guards rush in?
options: The dagger is a gift for Dong Zhuo.
Wang Yun is waiting outside the house.
He needs the guards to find his horse.
questions.explanation: 他立即跪下并将匕首说成礼物，用来掩饰刺杀企图。

evidence.quote: As guards rushed into the room, Cao Cao dropped to his knees. He held out the seven-star dagger. "A gift for you, sir!"

questions.question: What happens to Cao Cao at the end of the episode?
options: He returns to Dong Zhuo to apologize.
Soldiers stop him and say he is under arrest.
He reaches his family home without being seen.
questions.explanation: 故事最后，士兵在中牟县拦住曹操，拿着通缉令宣布逮捕他。

evidence.quote: After another day of riding, he began to feel safe. But that changed in Zhongmu County. Cao Cao came across a group of soldiers blocking the road. One soldier stepped forward, holding a "Wanted" poster. "Cao Cao! You're under arrest!"

questions.question: Why is Dev going to the cereal factory?
options: He needs to buy food for Nero.
It is Take Your Kid to Work Day.
He has lost his school backpack.
questions.explanation: 爸爸问戴夫是否准备好参加带孩子上班日，戴夫期待参观工厂。

evidence.quote: "Ready for Take Your Kid to Work Day, Dev?" Dev grinned. "Totally! I can't wait to tour the factory."

questions.question: Why does Dad say Nero cannot come?
options: Nero has to visit Pam.
The factory is too far away.
Dogs are not allowed around the food.
questions.explanation: 爸爸明确说，食品周围不允许有狗。

evidence.quote: "Dad, can Nero come?" Dev asked. "No," Dad said. "Dogs aren't allowed around the food."

questions.question: Where does Nero hide?
options: In Dev's backpack, under his lunch.
Inside Dad's coat pocket.
In a box of Crackle Pops.
questions.explanation: 尼罗跳进戴夫的背包，躲在午餐下面。

evidence.quote: He crept over to Dev's backpack. Nero hopped inside and slid under Dev's lunch.

questions.question: Why does Dev think his backpack is heavy?
options: He thinks Nero has hidden inside.
He thinks Dad packed a very big lunch.
He thinks he put too many books in it.
questions.explanation: 戴夫没有发现尼罗，而是猜爸爸装了一大份午餐。

evidence.quote: Dev came back and picked up his backpack. "Oof! It's heavy!" He laughed. "I guess you packed a really big lunch, Dad.

questions.question: What does Nero think at the end?
options: He is at a new dog park.
He is back in his own kitchen.
He is back at Dr. Shady's lab.
questions.explanation: 熟悉的声音和气味让尼罗以为自己又回到了谢迪博士的实验室。

evidence.quote: "Familiar sounds . . . familiar smells . . . I've been here before!" Nero gulped. "I'm back at Dr. Shady's lab!"

questions.question: Why does the mayor want to tear down the statue?
options: He does not want the king to see its changed appearance.
He wants to move it closer to the palace.
He needs its gold to buy the townspeople warm clothes.
questions.explanation: 市长不想让国王看到雕像变成这样，因此提议拆除雕像。

evidence.quote: The mayor clapped to get everyone's attention. "Yes, we must catch the thief. But the king must not see what happened to his beautiful statue." The mayor drew in a breath. "So we will tear it down!"

questions.question: Why does Swallow scold the townspeople?
options: They have given all their food to the hawk.
They refuse to let the prince speak to the king.
They want to destroy the statue that helped them.
questions.explanation: 燕子指出雕像牺牲自己的美丽改善人们生活，人们却要拆掉它。

evidence.quote: He chirped softly. "This statue gave away his beauty to make your lives better! And now you will tear him down? Shame on all of you!"

questions.question: Who can hear Swallow's words?
options: All the people in the crowd.
Only the statue.
The mayor and the king.
questions.explanation: 旁白明确说镇民听不见燕子，只有雕像能听见。

evidence.quote: But of course, reader, the townspeople could not hear Swallow. Only the statue could hear these words.

questions.question: Why did the prince ask Swallow to give away his gold and jewels?
options: He wanted to help unhappy people.
He wanted the hawk to leave the town.
He wanted the king to replace the statue.
questions.explanation: 王子看到人间的不幸，想帮助人们，于是请燕子协助。

evidence.quote: "Because from up here I see all the unhappiness in the land. I had to do something to help people. And so, I asked Swallow to help me."

questions.question: What happens at the end of the episode?
options: Swallow becomes strong enough to fly away.
The hawk carries Swallow safely to the palace.
One of the statue's arms breaks off and falls toward Swallow.
questions.explanation: 最后雕像的一只胳膊折断，朝燕子落去，故事留下悬念。

evidence.quote: With another crack, one of the statue's arms snapped off. Then it fell down, sailing toward Swallow!
